name: 007-actor-critic
description: Actor-Critic (Online TD) — One-step advantage, per-frame updates

stateFeatures.name: dx
stateFeatures.description: Horizontal distance to the current pipe

stateFeatures.name: dy
stateFeatures.description: Vertical distance to the center of the current pipe gap

stateFeatures.name: gap
stateFeatures.description: Height of the current pipe gap

stateFeatures.name: dxNext
stateFeatures.description: Horizontal distance to the next pipe

stateFeatures.name: dyNext
stateFeatures.description: Vertical distance to the center of the next pipe gap

stateFeatures.name: gapNext
stateFeatures.description: Height of the next pipe gap

actor.loss: -log π(a|s) * A - 0.01 * H(π) (policy gradient + entropy bonus)

critic.loss: huber (delta 5) on the one-step TD error

exploration.description: Action sampled from actor's probability distribution (no epsilon-greedy)
